dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Look at those beauties, soon they'll be hanging in lovely little displays.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Right on my wall, where they belong.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Huh... I missed this last time.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Looks kind of... lived in? There's no bed though... strange.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: No caving for me today, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Well isn't that terrific. What the hell moved those rocks?

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: There's not many butterflies around at this time..

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: What are these butterflies - They glow!
